strip_comments_preserve_positions: strip comments from Lean 4 code while preserving line and column positions by replacing with spaces
strip_comments_simple: strip comments from Lean 4 code by removing them entirely without preserving positions
detect_sorry_or_axiom: detect if Lean 4 code contains sorry or axiom keywords outside of comments
parse_diff_stats: parse git diff output and return the count of additions and deletions
find_declaration_headers: find theorem, lemma, def, and other declaration headers in Lean 4 source code using regex
